prompts.fish:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art sprite atlas for a cozy Godot farming game. Create ONE transparent sprite sheet containing exactly 12 DIFFERENT freshwater fish inventory icons, laid out in EXACTLY 4 equal columns x 3 equal rows, row major order. Entire canvas square 1024x1024, each cell 256x341? Instead use landscape 1024x768 exactly, four columns and three rows of 256x256. One isolated complete fish centered in each cell, generous transparent padding, no contact between cells. Row1: silver crucian carp (rounded silver-green body), common carp (golden olive scales), bluegill (small blue-green round body), largemouth bass (elongated moss green dark lateral stripe). Row2: rainbow trout (silver blue with muted pink lateral stripe), perch (golden yellow dark vertical stripes orange fins), catfish (slate blue, whiskers), northern pike (long narrow sage-green body). Row3: red koi (cream and warm red patches), goldfish (orange-gold flowing short tail), salmon (salmon pink silver body), freshwater eel (long curved dark olive body).
STYLE: tiny true low-resolution pixel sprites, as if each fish was hand drawn on a 16x16 or 24x16 pixel canvas and enlarged using nearest-neighbor. Silhouette facing LEFT, centered side view, one visible tiny dark eye. Extremely simple readable silhouettes and chunky square pixels, 5-7 colors per fish. Muted pastoral palette: sage greens #8eaa77, teal #78aaa3, cream #e6d9ac, warm tan #bb9269, muted salmon #cf8f76, outline #776953. Warm subdued outlines, tiny top-left pale highlight, flat 2-step shading. Compatible with 16x16 farm tiles, tiny cream chickens and tan cows, simple seed packet inventory icons. No realistic scales or high-resolution texture. Solid colored pixel clusters only. NO text, labels, gridlines, swatches, background, water, environment, drop shadows, borders or decorative effects. Genuine transparent alpha background. All fish similar inventory icon scale, under 65% cell width, eel curves to fit. Exactly one fish per cell, exactly 12 total.
prompts.fishing:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel farming game fishing equipment atlas. Create a transparent PNG sprite sheet with EXACTLY 4 columns and 2 rows, landscape 2:1 aspect ratio. Exactly one isolated complete item centered within each of the eight equally sized cells, ample transparent margins. Row 1 in order: primitive bamboo fishing rod with linen wrapping and simple dangling hook; sturdy wood fishing rod with copper reel; steel-blue fishing rod with silver reel; master fishing rod made of dark teal wood with warm gold fittings. Rods diagonal from bottom left to top right, bent tip and a visible short fishing line and hook, all contained in their cell, no person. Row 2 in order: classic cream-and-muted-red round fishing bobber; single curled earthworm bait; small brass fish-shaped fishing lure with hook; small wooden fishing tackle box with teal lid and a visible spool.
Style: true tiny pixel-art inventory icons for a 16x16-tile cozy pastoral farming game. Each icon looks hand-drawn at 24x24 native pixels, enlarged with sharp nearest-neighbor square pixels. Very simple chunky low-resolution clusters, 5-8 colors per item, muted tan #bb9269, cream #e6d9ac, sage #8eaa77, blue-gray #789a9c, dull gold #c7ae72, dark warm outline #776953. Flat two-tone shading, small upper-left highlight. Short sturdy readable shapes. Transparent background with actual alpha. No white background, no checkerboard, no shadows, no text, labels, grid, numbers, environment, characters, water or gradients. Exactly 8 different objects, no objects spanning or crossing cells.
prompts.crops:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: reusable crop growth sprite atlas for a cozy 16x16 pixel farming game. Make one square transparent sprite sheet with EXACTLY SIX columns and SIX rows of equal square cells, 36 isolated sprites in total. Each row is one crop and progresses left to right through exactly these six stages: 1 a small tan seed packet showing a tiny crop symbol, 2 tiny two-leaf sprout rooted in a very small soil tuft, 3 young leafy plant, 4 larger developing plant with immature fruit, 5 fully mature plant with clearly recognizable ripe produce, 6 one isolated harvested vegetable or fruit with no dirt. ROW1 POTATO, row2 CORN, row3 STRAWBERRY, row4 PUMPKIN, row5 CABBAGE, row6 EGGPLANT. Potato mature foliage has tiny cream blossoms and a few tan tubers showing at base; corn has golden cobs in sage leaves; strawberry has ripe warm red berries; pumpkin is muted orange squat pumpkin and short vine; cabbage a layered pale sage rounded head; eggplant is muted purple fruit under green leaves. Every sprite fits inside its own cell with at least 18% transparent padding, all crops rooted at the same baseline inside each cell. Consistent front-facing 3/4 top-down farming-game view. Mature corn is taller than other crops but fits within its cell. No grass ground plane.
STYLE: tiny TRUE low-resolution pixel art, each cell looks like a hand-drawn 24x24 or 32x32 sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor, solid hard square pixel clusters, 5-8 colors per plant, no airbrush or smooth edges. Warm muted pastoral colors: sage greens #8eaa77 #b3c77a, straw cream #e6d9ac, tan #bb9269, muted orange #cf9a69, muted red #c58372, muted lavender #95859d, warm brown outline #776953. Match cute tiny cream chickens and tan cows, simple existing carrot/turnip/tomato/wheat sprite sheets. Flat two-step shading. Actual transparent background alpha, no white canvas, no checkerboard, no ground shadows. No text, labels, grid lines, frames, scenery or overlapping sprites. Exact 6x6 regular grid with 36 sprites, do not add or omit stages.
prompts.animals:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: farm animal four-direction idle sprite atlas for a cozy pixel-art farming game. Transparent portrait sprite sheet, EXACTLY FOUR columns and SIX rows of equal square cells (2:3 canvas aspect ratio). Exactly 24 isolated complete animal sprites, one per cell. Each row one species. Row1 a white-and-cream duck with muted orange beak and little feet. Row2 a fluffy cream sheep with warm gray face and short legs. Row3 a small muted blush pink pig with snout and tiny curled tail. Row4 a tan goat with short horns and tiny beard. Row5 a pale gray rabbit with tall ears and cream belly. Row6 a small chestnut horse with dark brown mane, cream muzzle and hooves. For EVERY row the four columns are: 1 front view facing DOWN toward viewer, 2 rear view facing UP away from viewer, 3 side view facing LEFT, 4 side view facing RIGHT. Neutral standing idle poses, all feet aligned to the same baseline per cell. The animal remains the same character, markings, proportions and scale across its four views. Clear front vs back view, visible tail in rear view, eye visible on side views. Horse is compact pony-proportioned so it fits inside a square cell.
STYLE: extremely cute tiny true low-resolution pixel sprites matching 16x16 tile pastoral farming games, cows and chickens with small black square eyes, compact chubby bodies, short legs, friendly neutral faces. Each sprite looks hand-drawn on a native 24x24 pixel canvas (horse 32x32) enlarged with crisp square pixels, 5-7 muted colors per species, flat two-step shading, warm thin tan-gray outline #8c7b66. Pastoral palette: cream #eee3c2, tan #c3a075, muted dusty pink #d6aa9b, sage-gray #a6b3a0, soft brown #9b7b61. Less detail is better. Front-facing tiny animals with no clothing, accessories, fences, grass, baskets, scenery, text, labels or grid lines. No realistic fur, no high-resolution texture, no smooth gradients, no shadows. Real transparent alpha background. Every animal entirely inside its equal cell, generous 18% padding, no overlap, exactly 6 rows x4 columns.
